cards.text: Israel is camped in Shittim. Friend, I'll be honest with you, this one is a heavy chapter. The men of Israel begin to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab.

cards.question: The daughters of Moab also invite the Israelite men to something. What is it?
At the sacrifices for Moab's gods, the Israelites only watch. They never eat or bow down.

cards.text: It doesn't stop there. Israel joins in worshiping a false god, Baal of Peor.

cards.question: Israel has joined in worshiping Baal of Peor. How does the LORD respond?

answers.text: He waits to see what they do
He sends Moab out of the land

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, an order.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before Him. Why?

answers.text: So His fierce anger may turn away from Israel
So Moab will see it and be afraid of Israel
So the leaders cannot run off to join Moab

cards.question: Next, Moses gives an order to the ___ of Israel: each of them must kill all of his men who joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.

cards.text: Just then an Israelite man brings a woman from Midian, a different people from Moab, to his family. And he does it in front of Moses and the WHOLE congregation of Israel.

cards.question: When the Israelite man brings the Midianite woman to his family, Moses and the congregation are weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, sees it. He gets up from the assembly and takes a spear in his hand.
Phinehas follows the Israelite man into the tent. He drives the spear through both of them, through the man and on through the belly of the woman.
Something has been striking down the Israelites. And after what Phinehas does, it's halted.

cards.question: Phinehas acts, and the ___ against the Israelites is halted.
The plague against the Israelites is halted. How many died in it?

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses, and friend, He's talking about Phinehas. He says Phinehas has turned His wrath away from the Israelites, so that He did not consume them.

cards.question: What does the LORD say about Phinehas that explains why His wrath turned away?

answers.text: He was zealous for the LORD's sake
He was merciful to the guilty man
He was humble before the assembly

cards.question: Phinehas turned the LORD's wrath away. So the LORD tells Moses to declare that He is granting Phinehas His covenant of ___.
The LORD's covenant with Phinehas will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants.
Besides being zealous for his God, what else does the LORD say Phinehas did for the Israelites?

cards.text: Now the man in the tent finally gets a name, and he's not just anybody. Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

cards.question: The Midianite woman killed with Zimri gets a name too: Cozbi, the daughter of ___.

cards.text: The LORD isn't finished talking to Moses yet. And this time it's an order: "Attack the Midianites and strike them dead."

cards.question: Why does the LORD tell Moses to attack the Midianites?

answers.text: They deceived Israel in the matter of Peor
They blocked Israel's road into Canaan
They raided Israel's camp in the night
